title: Rethinking Indic AI from a Lens of Cultural Heritage Preservation

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing indigenous/community worldviews with mainstream worldviews using semantic analysis of embedding neighborhoods and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) on rural colloquial speech corpora.
Analyzing the linguistic homogenization, token fragmentation, fertility scores, and the hidden dominance of English as an internal pivot language (Anglocentric bias) in multilingual models.
